verdict.rationale: Buzz's agents work inside the product on your workspace data. When @mentioned, they search six months of conversation history and post the relevant threads back into the channel, and they can answer from agent memory. This is grounded, in-product AI output from your data, but it depends on connecting an ACP agent and is framed as on-demand Q&A rather than a dedicated insights or suggestions feature. Missing for 10: proactive or automatic AI insights and suggestions, any documented analytics or summary output over workspace data, and independent hands-on corroboration of answer quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Agents search six months of history and post the threads, not vibes.
The harness listens for @mentions on the relay, prompts your agent, and the agent replies using the Buzz CLI.
Answers from harness-seeded cold memory without the value appearing in channel history
